API.pattern_from_guard: guard AST, ordered distinct prefix_binders, source label => literal-receptor-pattern-v1 record
API.extract_pattern: witness plus declared ordered premise ASTs => pattern record
API.literal_guard_match: pattern record plus closed quantifier-free recipient AST => status/bucket/successful bindings/reason
API.evaluate_pattern: pattern record plus selected records {key,formula_code,formula} => per-key comparisons/matches and aggregate bucket
API.ReceptorOrder: same graph interface as frozen ForwardOrder; complete chosen keys only; no native/logic oracle

extractors.instantiate: Require exact declared universal as outer implication antecedent. Inspect consequent; peel leading universal binders with distinct nonempty string names; immediate implication guard only.
extractors.mp: Read exact first ordered premise as a rigid zero-slot guard; require second ordered premise literally equals implication(first, witness output). Do not inspect equality output as a guard and do not peel a quantified MP antecedent.
extractors.other_rules: neutral, including equality-substitution and named axiom recipes

syntax.literal_compound_term_constructors: Recursive fun(name,args) supported, including pattern slots inside constructors.
syntax.slot_images: Only closed fun(name,[]) with nonempty string name; different slots may share the same image.
syntax.rigid_constants: Already completed instantiation constants stay literal; cannot be rebound.
syntax.prefix_slots: Exactly variables in the distinct peeled leading prefix; free/out-of-scope variables neutral.
syntax.unsupported: Repeated/shadowed/empty prefix names; nested quantified guard or quantified/free recipient; unknown constructor or empty symbol; compound slot image. Literal or/exists are neutral in this first narrow subset.
syntax.no_rewrites: No conjunction flattening, commutativity, equality symmetry, logical consequence, unification of selected proof commands or satisfiability test.

pair_precedence: Validate pattern/recipient shape first. Then compare literal tree in ordered traversal. Any definite constructor/polarity/symbol/arity/repeated-image mismatch dominates unsupported image elsewhere; otherwise an unsupported compound slot image is neutral. Successful bindings only; nonmatch/neutral bindings are empty.
aggregation: Any exact supported selected match => match. Otherwise at least one supported nonmatch => nonmatch, even with other neutral recipients. Otherwise neutral. Nonmatch describes only the supported selected subset, never logical impossibility.
complete_score: unchanged old readiness tier, then receptor bucket, then original AST size/canonical witness/recipe index/ordered references
readiness: Exact original per-key tier conditions copied literally, substituting only the local name selected_outputs for historical proved. Physically selected output constraints may have pending ordered sources and are not established hypotheses/derivations.
selected_only: Collect g.selected output codes/formula ASTs and exact keys. No formula from g.m or an empty row is consulted; same formula at distinct selected keys remains distinct.
fallback: No candidate removal, merging, changed row scheduling, threshold, match-count bonus, degree update, marking, exclusion or descriptor. Every old legal alternative remains.

trace_schema.registry: Full per-recipe pattern records once in each new-control result.
trace_schema.per_branch: Selected exact key/formula-code records; per-recipe label/bucket/matches with bindings and distinct keys; count/label counts and SHA of every comparison; SHA of full sorted {key,score} stream.
trace_schema.forced: receptor_feature_trace is null; forced singleton uses exact base key with no stale branch feature trace.
trace_schema.timing: Aggregate separate selected-collection, pattern preparation, literal matching, score-feature, sort, permutation and payload/hash clocks; enclosing search/trace/order clocks overlap and must not be summed.

pure_controls.scope: Pure AST/selected-record only, no actual graph/order/model/search/native or mathematical proof acceptance.

scope_limit: Finite formula-color point model still differs from universal shared FOL-machine Wang palette. This authored fixed feature is not new RL training or a proof-search superiority claim.
